Audinate:AVIO-AO2.disambiguation: AVIO-AO2 is the 2-channel Dante-to-analog OUTPUT adapter. The shared family datasheet covers AI1/AI2/AO1/AO2; extract specs ONLY for the column or row matching '2 Channel Analog Output' / 'ADP-DAO-AU-0X2'. AVIO-AO2 has 0 analog inputs and 2 analog outputs (XLR-M).

Audinate:AVIO-AI2.disambiguation: AVIO-AI2 is the 2-channel analog-to-Dante INPUT adapter. Shared family datasheet; extract ONLY the '2 Channel Analog Input' / 'ADP-DAI-AU-2X0' column. AVIO-AI2 has 2 analog inputs (XLR-F) and 0 analog outputs (it converts analog to Dante; the only 'output' is the Dante network).
